body: Merged upstream/main (81a82b7a). The only conflict was in `geo_row_hover.rs`: this PR's test and #1519's viewport-hover test were both appended there, and both are kept. Quick gate green (ui suites: 816 passed).

<!-- pr-reviewer: 81a82b7a0a7de319a8de1a954442221247f36184 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The remove button precedes the row controls and label. The label uses the remaining width and shows its full text on hover. The existing selection commands and hover logic remain intact. The body includes before and after screenshots.

I checked the change against the current upstream `AGENTS.md` and issue #1688. I tested locally after a clean trial merge with upstream main at `d3e779907018a9483902c6edc286cf9472712e3d`.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --no-run` | Passed |
| UI library tests, from `crates/ui` | 1,017 passed; 6 ignored; 0 failed |
| `boundary` | 3 passed |
| `boundary_picks` | 7 passed |
| `sinker_setup` | 2 passed |
| `tap_hand` | 3 passed |
| `theme_example` | 3 passed |
| `theme_files` | 15 passed |
| `waterjet_tool` | 1 passed |
| `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |

The new default-size test passed. All three existing row-hover tests passed. The integration suites follow the quick gate map. No GitHub runner was used.

Requested changes: none.

This change does not alter posted G-code, geometry, collision checks, gouge checks or stock simulation. No goldens changed. Safety mutations were not required and were not run. I did not run the GUI or the ignored tests. The contributor's draft state stays unchanged.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
